name: Two households request the same free slot with neither request answered

statusDetails.message: Request: both households POST /api/standing-slots/request for Tuesday 17:00 in pukuhuone 8, apartment 12 and apartment 3; both request bodies were sent before either response was read (send gap 0.093 ms). Observed: apartment 12 HTTP 200 confirmed slot ss-1 17:00–18:30; apartment 3 HTTP 409 slot_held, message "The slot on Tuesday at 17:00 in pukuhuone 8 is already held.", holder 12. Re-read: schedule holder 12; posted list only apartment 12; heater heats that one window; invoicing has one standing_slot_charge for apartment 12. Consequence: exactly one request was confirmed, the other was refused because the slot is held, and no derived view shows two holders.

labels.name: story
labels.value: Two households requesting one free slot leave exactly one holder

steps.name: Given Tuesday at 17:00 in pukuhuone 8 is free
And neither the household in apartment 12 nor the household in apartment 3 holds it
When both households request a standing slot on Tuesday at 17:00 in pukuhuone 8
And the second request is made before the first has been answered
Then exactly one of the two requests is confirmed
And the other is refused because the slot is held
And exactly one household holds the Tuesday 17:00 standing slot in pukuhuone 8
And no derived view shows two holders for it

statusDetails.message: Posted list, heater and invoicing each show the single apartment 12 booking.
